LEAF 15f2 — COMPLETE AND PUSHED. Gerrit 2506, commit 3c2e305ae8dc, 28 files / 1099 insertions.
https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2506

TIGHTENING OUTCOME: the corrected env rule surfaced TWO MORE hazards beyond my six (previously
undecidable; the one-hop resolver traced them to local dict literals whose only os.environ was in a
value) — test_harness_shims.py:53 and test_release_guards.py:146. All 8 FIXED, ZERO marked: every
one of those children is a plain git/make/bash/python -c invocation that never reads the store, so
pinning REBAR_ROOT is inert to the assertion and removes the hazard permanently. Running total
across both rounds: 10 hazards FIXED, 24 MARKED (the 24 are root-axis repo-policy/gate self-tests
whose assertion IS the real committed tree).

DEFECT-SEEDED MUTATION (sandboxed) — AND A SURVIVING MUTANT I HAD TO FIX:
  round 1: baseline 21 | M1 loose-env-rule 4 FAILED | M2 break callee resolution 21 PASSED (SURVIVED)
           | M3 fail-the-undecidable 2 FAILED | restored 21
  M2 SURVIVING was a real gap in MY oracle: my false-positive tests asserted 'no findings', which
  cannot distinguish a callee correctly IGNORED from one wrongly MATCHED but harmless — both yield
  zero findings. Reshaped both so misresolution is consequential (the local run() and the asyncio.run
  call now pass cwd=REPO_ROOT, so a resolver that matches on the bare attribute name reports a hazard).
  round 2: M1 4 FAILED | M2 1 FAILED | M3 2 FAILED | restored 21. All three now caught.
This is the mutation step doing exactly its job: a tautological test caught and repaired.

MERGE + PRE-FLIGHT: merged to 419 lines / 25 tests. Two self-inflicted snags fixed:
 - the merge duplicated the loader block (F811) — deduped;
 - a HOUSE GATE I had not hit before, check_comment_hygiene.py, rejects rot-prone references: my
   docstring cited a bare commit SHA. Replaced with the ticket id ec07-692f. Source comments carry
   current state; the ticket system owns history.
make lint rc=0, mypy clean 728 files, 25/25 tests, --collect-only tests/unit exit 0.

ACCEPTED DEVIATION: tests/_subprocess_isolation.py is 506 lines, 6 over the 200-500 house target,
far under the 800 cap. The overage is prose explaining a non-obvious rule; not worth trimming.

STACK: 2503 (8ce5 parity) -> 2504 (f9b9 mirrors) -> 2505 (b0ac atomic writes) -> 2506 (15f2 guard).
REMAINING: 0880 reports (a) and (b) written, (c) + ADR 0110 to go; 9ca8 needs a 4th remediation.
